collection.title: Mercedes-Benz S Class Saloon 2000 to 2005 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Mercedes-Benz S Class Saloon 2000 to 2005 (W220) will fit, this model requires a 28" wiper blade on both the drivers side on the passengers side. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
